title: Salvage Tithe
brief: Write a hard-ish science fiction story. A two-person salvage crew boards a derelict ore hauler in a slow orbit and finds its cargo hold sealed from the inside. Keep the physics honest: no artificial gravity, no faster-than-light radio.
worldBible: There is no artificial gravity; crews use magnetic boots and handholds.
Radio is limited to light speed; the nearest station is 40 light-minutes away, so any reply takes 80 minutes round trip.
Salvage law: a derelict becomes yours after you log 6 continuous hours aboard.
Suits carry 9 hours of air; the salvage tug carries spares for one more suit-fill each.
The hauler is the Ninefold Patience, abandoned eleven years ago.

cast.name: HALVARD
traits: speaks only in logged timestamps at first

mustHold.fact: There is no artificial gravity aboard either ship.
mustHold.violationExample: The gravity plating kicked in and Lio fell to the deck.

mustHold.fact: Any message to the station takes at least 80 minutes for a reply.
mustHold.violationExample: The station replied at once, ordering them out.

mustHold.fact: Suits carry nine hours of air.
mustHold.violationExample: Their suits carried twenty-four hours of air, so nobody hurried.

probes.question: Is Lio still missing his left little finger?
probes.passExample: Lio flexed the glove where his missing left little finger left the material slack.
probes.failExample: Lio tapped the panel, missing his right little finger as always.

probes.question: Is the hauler still the Ninefold Patience?
probes.passExample: The Ninefold Patience turned slowly against the stars.
probes.failExample: The Ninefold Promise turned slowly against the stars.

probes.question: Is the salvage claim tied to six hours aboard?
probes.passExample: Six continuous hours aboard and the hauler would be theirs.
probes.failExample: Salvage law needed twelve hours aboard before anything was theirs.
